assertions: A1: POST /threads/:id/runs/wait returns a 200 response with content-type application/json and an empty body when the route returns undefined.
A2: POST /threads/:id/runs/wait returns 200 and a JSON body for a route that returns an object (e.g. { ok: true }).
A3: When a route execution throws, POST /threads/:id/runs/wait returns 500 with a JSON body whose error.kind is "execution_error".
